Supply Chain Commercial Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain Spot Buy Analyst to join our dynamic team in the oil and gas or petrochemical industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing contracting and procurement processes, contract negotiation, tender evaluation while staying compliant with procurement policies.

This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, capable of executing timely, compliant, and cost-effective purchases while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders, managing supplier relationships with accountability, and proactively driving continuous process improvements.

Accountability

• Apply the Contract & Procurement best practices while focusing on contribution to the business drivers and not compromising on compliance for HSSE, Ethics & Compliance, Code of Conduct, Laws, and regulations.
• Conduct identification of need, finding and qualifying the suppliers, requesting proposals, negotiating with suppliers, contracting, delivery and analyzing results.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to assess potential suppliers and ensure transparent, fair, and competitive bidding processes.
• Perform comprehensive financial and commercial analysis of bids to ensure alignment with technical specifications, budgetary constraints, and strategic goals.
• Lead contract negotiations with suppliers and vendors to secure favorable terms, pricing, and conditions, while ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
• Perform various procurement and support functions including vendor data administration as well as invoice and payment processing.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders to identify possibility to shift recurring spot buys into strategic sourcing or contracts.
• Develop and manage a reliable supplier base, ensuring compliance with company standards and resolving delivery, quality, and service issue.
• Manage Supplier Relationship effectively and collaboratively drive continuous performance improvement via relevant contract key metrics (EG: HSSE, Operations, Cost, etc).
• Monitor supplier performance and implement corrective actions to address any deviations from contractual obligations or service level agreements.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business or Engineering majors or related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in supply chain management, contracting and procurement.
• Proven experience in contract negotiation, tender evaluation, supplier relationship management and contract management. Experience in IT sourcing is preferred.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to act with urgency, accountability and manage multiple tasks and prioritize responsibilities.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficient in English both written and speaking and able to communicate in business language.
• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in using data analysis tools and software.
• Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as SAP or Oracle.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

wo-jpfa-JR5297.d:
Bagging Off Operator

Location: Singkawang, West Kalimantan
Company: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Job Description

Key Responsibilities
Packaging Operations
• Coordinate manpower allocation to ensure smooth execution of finished feed packaging activities.
• Prepare feed bags and packaging materials required for the bagging process.
• Prepare product labels and apply production codes to ensure full product traceability.
• Set up and operate the bagging scale system and supporting computer equipment to ensure correct bag weight settings.
• Supervise feed packaging activities throughout the bagging process to ensure compliance with operational standards.
• Optimize packaging time and workflow to achieve production targets and minimize delays.
• Print and verify bagging reports to monitor production output and mass balance results.

Quality Control and Inspection
• Perform routine checks on packaged feed weight to ensure compliance with net weight specifications.
• Inspect feed particle size, temperature, odor, and color to verify product quality standards.
• Verify feed contents and packaging type to ensure the correct product is packed in the appropriate bag.
• Monitor bag stitching quality to ensure bags are securely sealed, neatly stitched, and resistant to tearing.
• Conduct periodic scale accuracy verification to maintain weighing precision.
• Perform checkweigher inspection and calibration at the beginning of each shift to ensure measurement reliability.
• Maintain cleanliness of storage bins and internal bin surfaces to prevent contamination and ensure product quality.

Reporting and Documentation
• Prepare daily feed bagging production reports.
• Prepare production handover reports for warehouse operations.
• Prepare packaging bag usage reports to monitor packaging material consumption.
• Prepare overbag (overzak) handover reports.
• Prepare feed weight inspection reports.
• Prepare autonomous maintenance reports and record equipment conditions accurately.
• Ensure all operational records and reports are completed accurately and submitted on time.

Housekeeping, Safety & Compliance
• Maintain cleanliness of machines, equipment, and work areas to support a safe and efficient workplace.
• Wear and properly use all required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) during work activities.
• Follow Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies, company procedures, and work instructions at all times.
• Report safety hazards, quality deviations, or operational abnormalities to the supervisor promptly.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to packaging efficiency, quality, and workplace safety.

Bagging Off Operator

Lokasi: Singkawang, Kalimantan Barat
Perusahaan: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk

Deskripsi Pekerjaan (Job Description)

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Operasional Pengemasan

• Mengatur dan mengoordinasikan tenaga kerja untuk mendukung kelancaran proses pengemasan pakan jadi.
• Menyiapkan karung dan material kemasan yang diperlukan dalam proses bagging off.
• Menyiapkan label produk dan memberikan kode produksi untuk memastikan keterlacakan (traceability) produk.
• Melakukan pengaturan (setting) timbangan bagging off dan komputer pendukung untuk memastikan berat kemasan sesuai standar.
• Mengawasi seluruh proses pengemasan pakan ternak agar berjalan sesuai prosedur dan standar yang berlaku.
• Mengoptimalkan waktu dan proses pengemasan untuk memenuhi target produksi.
• Melakukan pencetakan dan verifikasi hasil bagging guna memantau output produksi serta keseimbangan massa (mass balance).

Pengendalian Mutu dan Pemeriksaan

• Melakukan pemeriksaan berat pakan secara berkala untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan standar berat netto.
• Memeriksa ukuran partikel (particle size), suhu, aroma, dan warna pakan guna memastikan kualitas produk sesuai spesifikasi.
• Memastikan jenis pakan yang dikemas sesuai dengan label dan jenis karung yang digunakan.
• Mengawasi kualitas jahitan karung agar rapi, kuat, dan tidak mudah sobek.
• Melakukan pengecekan dan kalibrasi akurasi timbangan secara berkala.
• Melakukan pemeriksaan timbangan checker pada awal setiap shift untuk memastikan ketepatan hasil timbang.
• Menjaga kebersihan bagian dalam bin penyimpanan guna mencegah kontaminasi dan menjaga kualitas pakan.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi

• Membuat laporan hasil produksi bagging/pengemasan pakan ternak.
• Membuat laporan serah terima hasil produksi kepada bagian gudang.
• Membuat laporan penggunaan karung pakan ternak untuk memantau pemakaian material kemasan.
• Membuat laporan serah terima overzak pakan.
• Membuat laporan hasil pengecekan berat pakan ternak.
• Membuat laporan perawatan mandiri (autonomous maintenance) peralatan area bagging off.
• Memastikan seluruh data operasional terdokumentasi secara akurat dan tepat waktu.

Housekeeping, K3, dan Kepatuhan

• Menjaga kebersihan mesin, peralatan, dan area kerja untuk mendukung lingkungan kerja yang aman dan nyaman.
• Menggunakan Alat Pelindung Diri (APD) sesuai ketentuan selama bekerja.
• Mematuhi seluruh prosedur, instruksi kerja, dan standar Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) yang berlaku.
• Melaporkan potensi bahaya, penyimpangan kualitas, atau kondisi tidak normal kepada atasan.
• Berpartisipasi dalam upaya peningkatan berkelanjutan terkait kualitas, produktivitas, dan keselamatan kerja.
